What is scaled dot-product attention?

Scaled dot-product attention

Attention lets each token weigh every other token. For queries QQQ, keys KKK and values VVV:

Attention\mathrm{Attention}(Q, K, V) = \mathrm{softmax}\left(\frac{QK^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}}\right)VAttention(Q,K,V)=softmax(QKᵀ/√dₖ)V

The scaling factor keeps the softmax from saturating when d_k is large.

  1. Compute similarity scores.
  2. Normalize them with softmax.
  3. Take a weighted sum of values.
python
def attention(q, k, v):
    scores = q @ k.T / math.sqrt(k.shape[-1])
    return softmax(scores) @ v
VariantComplexityNotes
Full attentionOO(n^2)O(n²)Exact
Linear attentionOO(n)O(n)Approximate | kernel trick

In short: attention is a learned, content-based lookup.
